contributions.statement: Do not pick an embedding model for agent code retrieval from snippet-level code-search leaderboards: the same embedders that reach NDCG@10 ~72 on snippet search score ~20 on issue-to-edited-code localization, Java is among the hardest languages, and BM25 beats several dense models; evaluate on your own issue-to-diff pairs instead.
contributions.evidence: §4.2 Table 3 (Qwen3-Embedding-8B L1 71.7 vs L2 20.3 NDCG@10), Fig. 4 (L1 only moderately correlates with L2), Table 17 (BM25 L2 13.0 beats bge-m3/gte-Qwen2/CodeRankEmbed), §4.5 Table 4 (Java L2 10.2 vs Python 18.4 for 0.6B). COI medium per review.

contributions.statement: Fine-tuning an embedder on your own PR history (issue text to edited chunks) improves edit localization substantially but lowers general snippet-search quality, so keep the tuned model scoped to agent localization.
contributions.evidence: §4.3 Table 3: Qwen3-8B-SFT L2 32.8 vs 20.3, L3 50.2 vs 34.4; L1 drops 71.7 to 63.0 (0.6B: 66.9 to 58.1). Single training run; training repos disjoint from SWE-bench family (App. B).

reason: Shows with strong evidence that generic code-search benchmarks do not predict agentic localization, including for Java, and quantifies the SFT trade-off. Single-repo queries only.
